description: A rig names one character, its parts, the joints that move those parts, and named poses. It is an authoring-time format only: it expands to existing shape nodes and the existing x, y, scale, rotation, opacity tracks, so no new node type and no evaluator change. A part's `node` names a shape node in the target scene; whether that node exists is checked at expansion time (Unit C), not here, because a rig file carries no scene. `meta` carries the frame context (fps, duration) the keyframe and expansion steps need, and lets the existing `hme validate` report builder read the file.

parent.description: Id of the parent joint this joint moves with, or null. A joint chain (for example elbow under shoulder) rotates and translates together. Must not form a cycle.

part.description: Id of the part this joint moves. Must name a part in `parts`.

pivot.description: Pivot point in scene coordinates. Rotation joints rotate around it; translate joints anchor on it.

node.description: Id of the shape node in the target scene this part maps to. Checked at expansion time, not by rig validation.

items.description: One part's values in this pose, on the existing transform tracks (x, y, scale, rotation, opacity). At least one value field must be set.

part.description: Id of the part this state sets. Must name a part in `parts`.

title: Headless Motion Engine character rig
